artboards.title: 4 · Kernel bench — the last few ms

annotations.text:
The loop, left to right: you hand over a checkpoint and name the board it has to run on. We measure it there untouched — that becomes the benchmark. Four search loops then try to beat it, and every candidate is re-timed on the real board.

"CADENCE" is a placeholder name. Numbers are plausible for a 3.3B VLA on an Orin NX but they are illustrative, not measured.
